calls.title: Event Forwarder | MV Views
calls.summary: The team discussed prioritizing Avro schema registry integration to automate column management in BigQuery while maintaining control over schema changes. Nhat Ho and Michael Knowlton highlighted Avro’s effectiveness in handling schema updates and reducing manual migrations. User control over which event properties become columns was emphasized to avoid unnecessary sparsity. The preference for scheduled queries over materialized views was debated, as they allow for easier schema updates. Kafka topic management was also addressed, focusing on separating event streams for BigQuery and Clickhouse to streamline processes. Cost control measures were discussed, including avoiding automatic column creation and using JSON blobs to minimize storage expenses. The next steps involve implementing the Avro schema setup and clarifying Kafka topic creation.
calls.keywords: Kafka, BigQuery, Avro Schema Registry, Materialized Views, Event Forwarder, Schema Migration
calls.action_items:
**Nhat Ho**
Investigate and set up Avro schema registry, test schema pushing and migration scenarios to support schema-driven column creation and ingestion (34:52)
Explore schema discovery from event JSON blobs and build mechanism to detect new or removed fields per organization to enable dynamic schema updates (38:20)
Acquire or request sample production data from Clickhouse or other sources to validate schema discovery and UI mapping approach (39:24)
Create new Kafka topic for BigQuery event forwarding in Confluent cloud and test ingestion pipeline end-to-end (41:37)

**Michael Knowlton**
Assist Nhat with Avro schema registry setup and programmatic schema updates to ensure smooth schema lifecycle management (41:08)
Provide access or guidance on Kafka topic creation and management in Confluent cloud to facilitate event forwarder development (41:50)

**Jeremy Dorn**
Coordinate and prioritize MVP approach based on Avro schema driven ingestion to align development efforts (16:10)
Validate BigQuery JSON functions limitations in materialized views and benchmark JSON extraction performance to inform design decisions (05:08)
Support infrastructure planning for Kafka topic usage and parallel event pipelines to Clickhouse and BigQuery to ensure reliability and cost-effectiveness (28:56)
